data.one_liner: Convert numbers into words by locale ID supporting English and Malayalam.
data.what_it_does: Provides a simple API to convert numeric values into their word representations based on a specified locale identifier. Currently supports English and Malayalam languages.
use_when: You need to display numbers as words in English or Malayalam.
Building invoice or receipt generation apps requiring written number amounts.
avoid_when: You need support for languages other than English and Malayalam.
You require complex currency-aware number formatting.
strengths: Supports Malayalam in addition to English.
weaknesses: Very limited language support (only English and Malayalam).
